note: Business typologies of clients: activity code (SBI 2008, the Dutch version of NACE rev. 2; codes to verify) and the risk factors they carry, from Annex II (lower risk) and Annex III (higher risk) of Directive (EU) 2015/849, to which the Wwft refers. The risk band follows: higher if any Annex III factor, lower if only Annex II factors, otherwise standard.
